title: Log-based metrics and alerts built from a line of text

videos.script: Your program already writes a line when a payment is retried. Nobody has to change the code to count it. {{line}} A log-based metric counts the lines that match a filter, minute by minute. Suddenly a line of text is a number on a chart. {{counter}} Watch the quiet minutes, though. A minute with no matching line has no point at all. Not zero. Nothing. {{gap}} A distribution goes further. It reads a number inside each line, and keeps how the values spread. {{distribution}} And some lines matter the first time they appear. A deployment that skipped the signature check, for instance. For those, one line is enough to raise an alert. {{alert}}
